takeaway: In a fit patient the apex beat, the bottom left corner of the heart, lies in the 5th intercostal space, mid-clavicular line; cardiomegaly displaces it laterally.

lines.text: Where would you expect to feel the apex beat in a fit young patient?
In a fit patient, the apex beat represents the bottom left corner of the heart.
You will find it in the mid-clavicular line, right here.
Count down the steps: it is the 5th intercostal space.
lines.say: Count down the steps: it is the fifth intercostal space.

lines.text: Conditions such as cardiac failure can cause cardiomegaly, and the apex beat is then displaced laterally.
So the answer is the 5th intercostal space, in the mid-clavicular line.
lines.say: (clears throat) So the answer is the fifth intercostal space, in the mid-clavicular line.
